references.text: The sin offering with a male goat to make atonement is prescribed in Leviticus for leaders who have sinned
The male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for the people on the Day of Atonement
A male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for the whole congregation
The same regulation concerning a male goat as a sin offering at the New Moon festival
A male goat as a sin offering to make atonement at the Passover festival
A male goat as a sin offering to make atonement at the Festival of Weeks (Shavuot)
A male goat as a sin offering on the Day of Atonement, in addition to the sin offering for that day
A male goat as a sin offering at the Feast of Tabernacles
Christ entered the holy place with his own blood and secured eternal redemption, unlike the blood of goats and bulls
The sacrifices were repeated annually as a reminder of sins, because the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins
